svg.title: The two waits in isolation
svg.desc: Four probe runs on the RTX 5060 Ti for each of stock vLLM, the KV preemption and the change at its 16-token window, each time the runs' median and then their range: in panel a, the KV case, the voice turn's first token while two agent requests of 18k tokens hold the pool (stock vLLM 4,968 ms, 4,900–4,971; the KV preemption 290 ms, 219–290, 17 times sooner; the change 290 ms, 216–294); in panel b, the prefill case, its first token and then its 16th while three agent prefills of 10k tokens run, the 16th and the time a token between the two at stock vLLM 1,500 ms, 1,220–1,529, 60–66 ms/token; the KV preemption 1,350 ms, 1,211–1,528, 60–65 ms/token; the change 575 ms, 536–615, 16–20 ms/token.
